setup_instructions: 1. Copy this file to 'config.json' (do not commit config.json)
2. Replace YOUR_BETFAIR_USERNAME with your actual Betfair username
3. Replace YOUR_BETFAIR_PASSWORD with your actual Betfair password
4. Replace YOUR_BETFAIR_APP_KEY with your Betfair API app key
5. Replace PATH_TO_YOUR_CERTIFICATES_FOLDER with the path to your SSL certificates folder
